_README: Weekly AI budget in DOLLARS (working days only). weekly_usd = what you can spend Monday-Friday. remaining_usd = what you had left when you first started the lab with this file (later, tell the lab your balance from the Budget card: it re-aligns and learns the real price). prices = optional per-model price per 1,000,000 tokens (in = prompt, out = completion): fill them from your provider's page for exact dollars; without them the lab uses a deliberately HIGH blended price and learns the real one from your balance reports. This file is never overwritten by update.py.
